title: Deck outline (Phase 1 LLM plan)
description: Mirror of the outline JSON contract enforced by marp_slides.outline.parse_outline (the strict Phase 1 gate). Deliberate deltas, both toward the stricter canonical form the prompt teaches: (1) theme is matched case-sensitively here while parse_outline lowercases before its allow-list check; (2) minLength 1 approximates parse_outline's .strip()-non-empty rule (the evals/asserts/outline_contract.py assert closes that gap exactly). Unknown top-level and slide keys stay allowed: parse_outline ignores them for forward compatibility.

title.description: Deck title; non-empty text (assemble_deck YAML-quotes it into the frontmatter).

theme.description: Exactly one of the MARP_THEMES names from marp_slides/constructs.py (the prompt's theme list and the validator derive from the same source).

paginate.description: Optional: true numbers every slide (frontmatter paginate: true).

backgroundColor.description: Optional deck-wide solid background, strict '#RRGGBB' (validate_hex_color normalizes to uppercase).

backgroundImage.description: Optional deck-wide background image as a 1-based '#file:N' reference into the task's images input; N must be within the provided image count (bounds checked in evals/asserts/outline_contract.py).

footer.description: Optional short single-line footer shown on every slide.

header.description: Optional short single-line header shown on every slide.

slides.description: The ordered deck plan; non-empty (parse_outline) and capped at DEFAULT_MAX_SLIDES = 60 (marp_slides/settings.py). The per-task max_slides input (default 8, clamped 1..60) is enforced per test by evals/asserts/outline_contract.py.

title.description: Slide title; becomes the slide's heading, so it must be short.

summary.description: One or two sentences naming the concrete points the slide must cover; defaults to empty when omitted.

has_image.description: True only when this slide should show one of the task's provided images; at least image_count slides must set it (the image-coverage gate, mirrored in evals/asserts/outline_contract.py).
